headline: Stlican Shelf and Palantine Berm Surge as Bloody Clashes Persist
war_summary: Since the previous edition, the focal point of frontline movement has shifted toward Stlican Shelf and Palantine Berm, where immediate base exchanges erupted over the past two hours around Breaker Town, Vendett, and Windburn Landing. Stonecradle continues to witness fierce contention, absorbing over twenty-one hundred casualties in two hours alongside renewed struggles for The Dais and The Reach. Linn of Mercy remains the deadliest sector on the map, logging upwards of four thousand combined casualties over the same window despite base transitions pausing after earlier volatility at Lathair and Outwich Ranch. Further east, tactical shifts in Weathered Expanse and Marban Hollow have cooled into steady trench friction, while Nevish Line experienced an abrupt swell in casualties. Coastal sectors like Farranac Coast have likewise quieted from prior assaults, leaving central and shelf sectors under the heaviest sustained pressure.
